role: Preregistered contract for the v0.5.2 Navier-Stokes WSINDy fix. It changes only the bump-center stride diagnosed in docs/v052/diagnosis.md. It holds no v0.5.2 test number. It does not edit v0.5.1, v0.5, v0.4.1, or v0.4 artifacts. Burgers is not rescored.
question: After breaking the Kolmogorov-period lock on WSINDy bump centers, at what sensor density does numpy WSINDy recover the exact vorticity-form Navier-Stokes support on the existing generator?
not_claimed: a result on The Well shear_flow or Petrobras 3W
that an FNO denoiser was scored; that arm is optional and is skipped
a retuned threshold list after seeing test scores
that Kolmogorov forcing was moved to the right-hand side as a known term
that Burgers was rescored; those v0.5.1 numbers stay the record
that a sparsity finding is valid if the 64x64 noise-0 control fails
a change to any v0.5.1, v0.5, v0.4.1, or v0.4 number, protocol, or score file

aggregation.unit: one support set per seed per lattice per noise, from a single STLSQ fit that stacks every primary-family test instance
aggregation.seed_success: the recovered support equals the true support of that family
aggregation.exact_support_rate: fraction of the five seeds that succeed
aggregation.instance_exact_rate: mean over seeds of the fraction of test instances whose own STLSQ support is exact
aggregation.coeff_rel_error: mean over test instances and true terms of |c_hat - c_true| / max(|c_true|, 1e-12), after a least-squares refit of the recovered support on that instance

splits.assignment: by instance id before any windowing: train 0..n_train-1, validation n_train..n_train+n_val-1, test n_train+n_val..total-1
splits.note: The generator's n_val slot is the validation split used only to choose the STLSQ threshold.

ns2d.pde: ω_t + u · ∇ω = nu Δω + f,  u = ∇^⊥ ψ,  −Δψ = ω

burgers2d.reason: This study rescores ns2d only. Burgers v0.5.1 scores remain the record.

sensors.layout: equispaced square lattice, stride = N / n_side on the 64 by 64 grid

noise.model: additive iid Gaussian on observed field values, scaled by the clean-field standard deviation of that instance
noise.per_seed: realization seed is noise_seed + 100 * seed so the five seeds are distinct at every positive noise fraction

library.role: Same frozen candidate terms as v0.5 and v0.5.1. Kolmogorov forcing stays in the library as force_y. It is not subtracted as a known term. Derivatives of linear terms can move onto the test function; mixed products use spectral derivatives of the field on the grid that method sees.

wsindy.role: primary sparse identifier; same frozen choices as v0.5.1 except center_stride_fraction
wsindy.estimator: numpy WSINDy: compact polynomial test functions, trapezoidal quadrature, sequential thresholded least squares

test_function.center_stride_rationale: v0.5 and v0.5.1 used 0.25. On every lattice n in {8, 16, 32, 64} that equals one period of Kolmogorov k=4, so force_y, const, and force_x are rank-1. This value is 1/6. Then 4 * stride / n is not an integer at those lattices. Diagnosis: docs/v052/diagnosis.md.
test_function.time: one bump on each sensor burst

stlsq.selection: on the validation split only: maximize the number of primary-family validation instances with exact support; ties take the largest threshold

wsindy_raw.role: primary. WSINDy on the chosen sensor lattice. The field is not lifted and not denoised.

wsindy_fno.reason: This study isolates the diagnosed center-stride bug. The v0.5 FNO-denoise arm is not trained and not scored.

pysr.reason: PySR needs Julia. The skip is inherited from v0.5 and v0.5.1 and is recorded here before scoring.

positive_control.reading: If exact_support_rate is below 0.8 on the full 64x64 field at noise 0, that is a method or implementation failure, not a sparsity finding.

reported.name: min_lattice_at_bar
reported.definition: the smallest lattice name, in the frozen increasing order 8x8, 16x16, 32x32, 64x64, whose wsindy_raw exact_support_rate at noise 0.01 is >= 0.8; otherwise the string none

reported_not_bars: noise fractions 0.0, 0.02, 0.05 except the 64x64 noise-0 control
any Burgers number from this run

compute.ci: tiny smoke only: one manufactured library, one STLSQ recovery, one lattice mask, the registered stride is incommensurate with k=4. CI never trains or scores the study.
